name: The Night Watch
objective: Watch the square after dark. Someone is taking lanterns down — quietly, one by one.
intro: Midnight. The blue lantern burns. A shape on a ladder works faster than any festival hand should.
dialogue: Night Porter: "Registry's closed. Everything's closed. Go home."
Lantern Thief: "Not stealing. Returning. There's a difference."
lore_discovery: The thieves are not stealing lanterns — they are returning them, taking only the oldest ones down into the old quarter.
